subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The contrast was shocking.”?
options: The park had special systems to manage gas and water under the ground.
Their teacher explained that ocean water can carry things for a long distance.
Scientists explained that wetlands can hold water, support wildlife, and clean pollution naturally.
A new bench was placed under the old tree in the park.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「The contrast was shocking. The park had special systems to manage gas and water under the ground.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Their teacher explained that ocean water can carry things for a long distance.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Scientists explained that wetlands can hold water, support wildlife, and clean pollution naturally.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A new bench was placed under the old tree in the park.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The contrast was shocking. The park had special systems to manage gas and water under the ground.」，答案為「The park had special systems to manage gas and water under the ground.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The park had special systems to manage gas and water under the ground.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
